requirement.normalizedRequirement: Longitudinal local frames in side structures are to be dimensioned such that the combined effects of shear and bending do not exceed the plastic strength of the member. The plastic strength is defined by the magnitude of midspan load that causes the development of a plastic collapse mechanism.
requirement.section: Framing - Longitudinal local frames in side structures
requirement.source: UR I2 Structural Requirements for Polar Class Ships
requirement.sourceText: Longitudinal local frames in side structures are to be dimensioned such that the combined effects of shear and bending do not exceed the plastic strength of the member. The plastic strength is defined by the magnitude of midspan load that causes the development of a plastic collapse mechanism.

dependencyContract.comparisonModel: For each longitudinal local frame whose structuralLocation is sideStructureLocation, every represented load-case combined shear-and-bending demand must not exceed the member plastic strength/midspan plastic-collapse load. The clause is universal and does not require inventing a member or load case when none is represented.
